description: Every BulkDB window (main and w-<n>, docs/db-copy.md 1.1): app commands, file/folder pickers, focusing and closing windows (the page destroys its window when onCloseRequested is not prevented) and opening https install links (driver registry installUrl) in the default browser. The open-url command is scoped to https:// only: an unscoped allow-open-url denies every URL (empty allow list). No shell, no fs API from JS (SQL files and output are handled by core).
